docket_entries.description: THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF SOLOMON MOORE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WILLIAM LUDAN IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS BY PAULETTE SHERRY. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. AFTER THE HEARING RECESS, THE PARTIES TO CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF REQUESTS A DISMISSAL WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE.(SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $9,999.00 FILED BY MOORE, SOLOMON AS TO DEFENDANT LUDAN, WILLIAM ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-03-2021 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
